identity.name: BITCOIN 500
identity.existing_tagline: Stay informed. Never miss a significant Bitcoin move again. ₿
identity.one_sentence_description: A Telegram-first bot monitoring Binance BTCUSDT and sending threshold alerts with charts and scheduled market summaries.
identity.one_paragraph_description: BITCOIN 500 listens to Binance's BTCUSDT mini-ticker stream and compares price with its current alert reference (default threshold $500). When that threshold is reached, it sends a chart and movement details to Telegram. It sends a startup snapshot and completed-period reports. Optional integrations cross-post to X and publish Blogger posts with Dropbox-hosted chart images. Posts include a market-information disclaimer.

solution_flow: Operator configures Telegram token and destination and runs/deploys the bot.
Bot listens to Binance BTCUSDT mini-ticker and records first price as reference.
When movement reaches configured threshold (default $500), it sends price, change, UTC time, and chart, then resets reference.
Optional integrations publish startup/threshold updates to X and Blogger.
Scheduler posts prior UTC day/week/month reports to Telegram and optionally Blogger.

features.name: BTCUSDT stream monitoring
features.description: Listens to Binance one-second mini-ticker stream and reconnects after errors.
features.benefit: Keeps listening without processing each individual trade.

features.name: Threshold alerts
features.description: Sends price, movement, UTC time, and chart when change from reference reaches threshold; default $500.

features.name: Startup snapshot
features.description: Sends initial price and attempts a chart at startup.

features.name: Branded chart
features.description: Dark Binance Spot candlesticks, BTC volume, price, @bitcoin500alerts watermark; 48 15-minute candles for regular charts.

features.name: Scheduled market reports
features.description: Completed day/week/month reports with OHLC, net and percent move, BTC/USDT volume, chart.

features.name: X cross-post
features.description: Uploads chart and posts startup/alert content to X.

features.name: Blogger publishing
features.description: Publishes price updates and reports with context, timestamp, Telegram link, and chart.

features.name: Dropbox chart hosting and cleanup
features.description: Hosts Blogger images and deletes oldest bot chart images when projected account use exceeds 1.8 GB.
features.caveat: Old Blogger chart links may break after image deletion.
